pcs.pc_description: Categorize various habitats to prepare the corresponding activities
Collect additional information regarding the habitat from the local communities
Prepare relevant documentation including notes, photo collections, maps, etc
Analyze the habitat to identify appropriate activities
Prepare a list of equipment, manpower requirement, overheads etc. required for the corresponding activities
Formulate the budget for each activity
Design and customize various experiences including the activities as per the target group, guest expectations, ability, interests, budget, season, etc.
Collect the required details and relevant information about the guests
Make arrangements for special requirements of the guests related to old age, specially-abled, etc.
Arrange all equipment required for the nature activities preferred by the guests
Ensure the naturalist kit is functional, well- maintained, and updated
Prepare precise orientation and briefing script for the guests
Deliver a clear and precise orientation and briefing before beginning activities
Greet and receive the guests as per SOP
Interpret guests’ requirements, needs, and interests
Customize the experience/activity to match guest expectations, ability and interests- photographers, birders, children

Brief guests clearly in order to manage expectations about the do’s and don'ts, based on governing body rules in all relevant areas before every activity-guide the guests for informative, thematic, and fun-nature experiences like nature walks, safari, etc.
Make sure the guests are comfortable at all times
Provide information regarding various flora and fauna
Interpret different basic processes in nature and common animal behavior
Apprise the guests regarding various reptiles, amphibians and mammals along with their common traits
Brief the guests regarding sustainable living and adding value to conservation and ecology
Engage guests with interesting aspects of species like evolution, conservation status, etc
Provide clear, concise and interesting information about common processes in plants - photosynthesis, pollination, dispersal, parasitism, etc.
Ensure all ethical tourism practices are followed, whether or not implemented by governing body
Comply with the key provisions and guidelines outlined in the Wildlife Protection Act during all relevant activities
Demonstrate responsible behavior and adherence to legal requirements to support wildlife conservation efforts.
Deal with fairness and respect with local communities and partners

gs: GS2. identify and respond safely and promptly to emergency situations

pcs.pc_description: • handle emergencies such as animal attacks and snake/scorpion bites, natural calamities such • as landslides etc., health related emergencies and vehicle breakdowns
coordinate with vehicle driver to ensure that the vehicle for the wildlife safari is in good condition with good tyres and equipped with a spare tyre, a tool box and a tow rope
perform a basic risk assessment of the activity area before starting the activity and ensure that it is safe for tourists
check weather forecast before the activity
administer Wilderness First Aid (WFA) and Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR), when required
